newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - July 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - July 3.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- President Jiang Zemin attends a huge song and dance show in Beijing's Great Hall of the People to celebrate the return of Hong Kong to Chinese rule.
- Vice Premier Zhu Rongji says China would encourage grain production by paying higher-than-market state-set prices for surplus grain output.
- Signed article urges Communist Party members to put the interests of the people before their own.
- State Taxation Administration announces it would launch checks on the value-added taxes paid by commercial enterprises from July to September.
- China set ups a large transportation corporation to strengthen coastal shipping.
- China revokes the licences of 11 futures brokerages due to debts and irregularities.
- Chinese Foreign Minister Qian Qichen says Beijing would fulfill its "One Country, Two Systems" formula granting the returned British colony of Hong Kong a high degree of autonomy for 50 years.
